question: In India, which institution pioneered the first alternative to corneal transplantation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Hyderabad**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology:-**

 
 
• The institution in India that pioneered the first alternative to corneal transplantation is the Indian Institute of Technology **Hyderabad (IIT Hyderabad)**, in collaboration with the **LV Prasad Eye Institute (LVPEI)**
 
• The team of researchers, led by Dr. Sayan Basu and Dr. Vivek Singh from LVPEI, successfully 3D-printed the artificial cornea from human donor corneal tissue and transplanted it into a rabbit eye in August 2022.
 
• The transplant was successful, and the rabbit is now able to see clearly.
 
• **The 3D-printed cornea is made from a biocompatible hydrogel that is derived from human corneal tissue. **
 
• This means that the cornea is completely natural and free of any synthetic or animal components.
 
• This makes it very safe for use in human patients.
